test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.**

The (**captain with the members of his team**) failed to qualify for the African Nations Cup finals.

options.text: captain along with the members of his team
captain along side the members of his team

solution:
The correct answer is **"captain and his team."**
